QUEBEC CAMPING ASSOCIATION FONDS, TRENT UNIVERSITY ARCHIVES, 85-013
====================================================================
Fetched verbatim 2026-09-06 from https://archives.trentu.ca/index.php/85-013 and stripped of markup.
Dates 1948-1982. 90 cm of textual materials, 3 boxes. Creator: Quebec Camping Association.

SCOPE AND CONTENT (verbatim): "This fonds consists of correspondence, minutes of meetings, CAMP
VISITATION REPORTS, historical background papers from the standards committee, provincial board
reports, related files from Associ[ation]..."

ASSOCIATED MATERIALS (verbatim): "For related records see the Canadian Camping Association and
Ronald H. Perry fonds (82-016)."

WHAT THIS ANSWERS
-----------------
p_339 (the QCA's 1965 inspection report on Kanawana). Canadian Camping for April 1966 records that
Murray McFarlane "visited twenty-seven camps during the summer months, and completed an exhaustive
report on each camp", the camps charged $25.00 apiece. **BOX 1 FOLDER 1, "Camp visitation reports and
related correspondence, 1962-1968", is where that round would be filed.** A named box and folder, in
a named repository, for the most specific archival lead this project holds about its own subject.

p_346 (Quebec camp accreditation standards). **Box 1 Folder 21, "Q.C.A. Standards, correspondence,
1953-1973"**, and Box 1 Folders 7-10, the Provincial Standards Committee under Miss F. M. Kelly.

p_337 (Kanawana's Centenary Journey trip log, 1967). **Box 2 Folder 22, "Q.C.A. Centennial
Commission."**

A METHOD NOTE THAT COST NOTHING AND NEARLY COST A LOT
------------------------------------------------------
This page was first read through a summarizing fetch, which reported "Centenary/Centennial canoe
journey records (1965-1967): **Absent**" and "Member camp files: **Absent**". Box 2 Folder 22 is
literally headed "Q.C.A. Centennial Commission" and Box 2 Folder 12 is "personnel-camps, members".
**A SUMMARIZER'S NEGATIVE IS NOT THE DOCUMENT'S NEGATIVE.** Fetch the page raw and read the finding
aid yourself before recording anything as absent from it. This is rule 23's shape — a source searched
in one section is searched in one section — with a summarizing layer standing in for the section.
